ABBEYBANK.Description:
Abbey Bank Plc operates as a regional commercial bank in Nigeria.

The company offers commercial banking and mortgage services, such as savings accounts, fixed deposits, and current accounts.

The company also provides mortgage loans, short/medium term loans for property owners, mortgage refinancing, commercial real estate loans, and loans for women-owned real estate companies.

In addition, it offers financial advisory, digital banking services, debit cards, and prepaid cards. Further, it develops, AbbeyMobile, a mobile payment application that offers digital banking services.

The company was formerly known as Abbey Mortgage Bank Plc and changed its name to Abbey Bank Plc in June 2026.

Abbey Bank Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
ABBEYBANK.Key Executives: Mobolaji Adewumi (Chief Executive Officer); John Okonkwo (Chief Financial Officer); John Okonkwo (Chief Operating Officer)

ABCTRANS.Description:
ABC Transport Plc provides road transportation and logistics services in Nigeria and Ghana.

It operates through Coach, Sprinter, Shuttle, Cargo, Haulage, Hospitality CTI, and Trading segments. The company offers executive express, city transit, coach West Africa, cargo express, and courier services.

It also involved in the import and sale of vehicle spares; installation of motor vehicle speed governing devices; hospitality business; and assembly of heavy duty trucks.

In addition, the company operates the City Transit Inn hotel in Utako, Abuja. The company was formerly known as Associated Bus Company Plc and changed its name to ABC Transport Plc in August 2011.

ABC Transport Plc was founded in 1993 and is based in Owerri, Nigeria.
ABCTRANS.Industry: Local and Suburban Transit and Interurban Highway Passenger Transportation
ABCTRANS.Key Executives: Jude Nneji (Chief Executive Officer); Rex Okoro (Chief Financial Officer)

ACADEMY.Description:
Academy Press Plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides printing services in Nigeria.

The company prints educational and general books, commercial printing of diaries, labels, calendars, periodicals, annual reports, confidential and other printing.

The subsidiaries are involved in offset, digital, customized, confidential printing and, light and flexible packaging.

The company serves industries, individuals, corporate organizations, and governments. Academy Press Plc was incorporated in 1964 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.

ACCESSCORP.Description:
Access Holdings Plc operates as the financial holding company of Access Bank Plc that provide various banking products and services in Nigeria, rest of Africa, and Europe.

It operates in seven segments: Corporate and Investment Banking, Commercial Banking, Retail Banking, PFA, Payment, Insurance, and Digital lending.

The company offers deposit money banking, wealth and investment management, financial technology and ecosystem orchestration, payment, and consumer lending services.

It also provides finance solutions for short, medium, and long-term financing needs, as well as relationship banking services; manages and administers pension funds, such as retirement savings accounts funds I-VI and transitional contributions funds; and administers retirement savings accounts, voluntary savings schemes, and approved existing schemes.

In addition, the company offers Instant Pay, payment gateways, POS, card, and switch services; and insurance brokerage services, including insurance audits, risk management evaluation, specialized claims and uninsured loss recoveries, research and market reviews, and risk retention funds.

It serves individuals, multinationals, corporates, institutional and non-institutional clients, organizations, and the public sector.

Access Holdings Plc was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
ACCESSCORP.Key Executives: Innocent Ike (Chief Executive Officer); Emeka Ogbechie (Chief Financial Officer)

AFRINSURE.Description:
African Alliance Insurance Plc provides risk underwriting for life, and related financial and pension services to corporate and individual customers in Nigeria.

It operates through Life Insurance Business and Air Freight Business segments. The company offers group life policies, traditional life policies, and investment linked and annuity policies; cargo air transportation through leasing arrangements; annuity, children education, and mortgage protection plan insurance; takaful; endowment; and individual life insurance, as well as savings and investment products.

It also owns and manages airline; and operates restaurants, as well as provides catering, aviation, and hospitality services.

The company was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. African Alliance Insurance Plc operates as a subsidiary of Conau Limited.
AFRINSURE.Key Executives: Ayobami Ogunkeye (Chief Executive Officer); Akinbode Raji (Chief Financial Officer)

AFRIPRUD.Description:
Africa Prudential Plc provides technology and share registration services to public and private companies in Nigeria.

It offers premium share registration services, including robust data validation system, daily transaction update, secured cloud-based operating software, clean legacy data, robust share portal system, and omnichannels for investors' engagement; electronic transmission of annual report and notice of AGM, E-accreditation service, virtual attendance, real time voting, and regulatory report generation services; and investor relations services.

It also provides private placement, stock market listing, bonus issuances, and advisory services; and probate and transmission services, such as letters of administration, grant of probate, transmission of shares, amendment of grant, and certificate of additional assets.

Further, the company offers Invearn digital solutions that combines services of capital market operators to meet investors’ needs; Greenpole, an enterprise registrar operating solution that caters to the data management and end-to-end operations of registrars; and e-Agm, an event management solution used in organizing physical and virtual corporate events.

The company was formerly known as Africa Prudential Registrars Plc and changed its name to Africa Prudential Plc in March 2017.

Africa Prudential Plc was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
AFRIPRUD.Industry: Security and Commodity Brokers, Dealers, Exchanges, and Services
AFRIPRUD.Key Executives: Catherine Nwosu (Chief Executive Officer); Temitope Aiwerioba (Chief Operating Officer)

AFROMEDIA.Description:
Afromedia Plc provides outdoor advertisement services in airports, street furniture, and billboards in Nigeria.

The company operates through Transit and Road Side segments. It offers backlit boxes, electroluminescent structures, ultra-wave structures, drop down banners, and wall drapes for airport advertising; and lamp post banners, LED lamp post banners, illuminate advertising tower unipoles, and super 48 sheet structures light boxes for road side advertising.

The company also offers web virtual reality solutions. Afromedia Plc company was founded in 1928 and is based in Ikeja, Nigeria.
AFROMEDIA.Key Executives: Otunba Irewunmi Olopade (Chief Executive Officer); Olaniyan Olanrewaju (Chief Financial Officer); Patrick Nwabunie (Chief Operating Officer)

AIICO.Description:
AIICO Insurance Plc provides risk underwriting and related financial services in Nigeria.

It operates through Life Insurance, General Business, Health Management, and Asset Management segments.

The life insurance segment offers whole life, term assurance, guaranteed pensions, endowment pensions, mortgage endowment, savings, and protection products, as well as other long-term contracts.

The General Business segment provides auto, household, commercial, and business interruption insurance; and general insurance to individuals and businesses.

The Health Management segment offers prepaid health plans to cater for the health needs of individuals and corporate organizations.

The Asset Management segments offers portfolio management services, structured investments, and mutual funds for corporate and individual clients.

In addition, the company offers annuity, property, marine, fire, personal accident, home, and travel insurance, as well as marine, manufacturing, agricultural, and oil and gas insurance; and various risk plans.

It markets its products through insurance brokers and agents. The company was founded in 1963 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.
AIICO.Key Executives: Babatunde Fajemirokun (Chief Executive Officer); Bisola Elias (Chief Financial Officer)

AIRTELAFRI.Description:
Airtel Africa Plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides telecommunications and mobile money services in Nigeria, East Africa, and Francophone Africa.

It offers pre and post-paid wireless voice, international roaming, and fixed line telephony services; data services, including 4G and 5G, home broadband, fibre, and data centers; and mobile money services, such as digital wallet payments systems, microloans, merchant, savings, insurance, international, and international money transfers.

The company also provides messaging, value added, and tower sharing services, as well as infrastructure sharing, mobile commerce, and support services.

The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in London, the United Kingdom. Airtel Africa Plc is a subsidiary of Airtel Africa Mauritius Limited.

ALEX.Description:
Aluminium Extrusion Industries Plc manufactures and sells aluminum extruded profiles, billets, and roofing sheets in Nigeria.

The company was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Owerri, Nigeria. Aluminium Extrusion Industries Plc operates as a subsidiary of Tower Aluminium Nigeria Plc.
ALEX.Industry: Rolling, Drawing, And Extruding Of Nonferrous Metals
ALEX.Key Executives: Veeraraghavan Ganesh (Chief Executive Officer); Levi Amaihe (Chief Financial Officer)

ARADEL.Description:
Aradel Holdings Plc an integrated energy company, engages in the exploration, development and production of oil, natural gas, and petroleum products in Nigeria and internationally.

The company’s flagship asset is the Ogbele Marginal Field covering an area of 22.53 square kilometers located in Rivers State.

It also invests in non-oil and gas assets. Aradel Holdings Plc was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
ARADEL.Key Executives: Olanrewaju Falade (Chief Executive Officer); Adegbola Adesina (Chief Financial Officer)

AUSTINLAZ.Description:
Austin Laz & Company Plc manufactures and sells ice block machines and aluminum long spam roofing sheets in Nigeria.

The company’s product portfolio includes thermoplastic coolers and warmers; ice cream machines; PVC windows; and doors, as well as metrotile roofs, glazed roofing tiles, and automatic direct freeze series products.

It also manufactures and sells disposable plates, spoons, and cups for industrial applications. Austin Laz & Company Plc was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Benin City, Nigeria.
AUSTINLAZ.Key Executives: Austin Asimonye (Chief Executive Officer); U. Osamede (Chief Financial Officer)

AVACAP.Description:
Ava Capital PLC, through its subsidiaries, operates as a financial services company, provides investment banking, asset management, securities trading, and trusteeship services in Nigeria.

It specializes in capital raising (debt and equity), balance sheet restructuring, mergers and acquisitions (M and A), leveraged buyouts (LBOs), management buyouts (MBOs), and structured finance.

The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
AVACAP.Industry: Security and Commodity Brokers, Dealers, Exchanges, and Services

BAPLC.Description: Briclinks Africa Plc engages in the provision of telecommunication, internet, and installation services. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Abuja, Nigeria.

BERGER.Description:
Berger Paints Nigeria Plc manufactures, distributes, and sells paints and allied products in Nigeria.

It operates through three segments: Paints and Allied Products, Contract Revenue, and Investment Property Rental Income.

The company also leases real estate properties; and offers painting services. The company was incorporated in 1959 and is based in Ikeja, Nigeria.
BERGER.Industry: Paints, Varnishes, Lacquers, Enamels, and Allied Products
BERGER.Key Executives: Alaba Fagun (Chief Executive Officer); Adeleke Adeniyi (Chief Financial Officer); Celestine Aruoture (Chief Operating Officer)

BETAGLAS.Description:
Beta Glass Plc manufactures, distributes, and sells glass bottles and containers in Nigeria and internationally.

The company also offers crowns and crates. Its products are used by soft drinks, breweries, wine and spirits, pharmaceutical, food, and cosmetics companies.

The company also exports its products to Ghana, Burkina Faso, Guinea, Sierra Leone, Liberia and Angola.

The company was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. Beta Glass Plc is a subsidiary of Frigoglass Industries Nigeria Limited.
BETAGLAS.Industry: Glass And Glassware, Pressed Or Blown
BETAGLAS.Key Executives: Alexander Gendis (Chief Executive Officer); Timothy Ononiwu (Chief Financial Officer); Jagdish Agarwal (Chief Operating Officer)

BUACEMENT.Description:
BUA Cement Plc engages in the manufacture, sale and distribution of cement and related products under the BUA Cement brand in Nigeria and internationally.

It offers bagged and bulk cement products. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
BUACEMENT.Key Executives: Yusuf Binji (Chief Executive Officer); Chikezie Ajaero (Chief Financial Officer); Ladipo Ogunlesi (Head of Investor Relations)

BUAFOODS.Description:
BUA Foods PLC processes, manufactures, produces, and distributes food materials in Nigeria.

The company operates through Flour, Sugar, Pasta, and Others segments. It offers fortified and non-fortified sugar, as well as by-products, such as bagasse, molasses, and mud cakes under the BUA brand name; raw sugar and refined sugar; flour and bran; pasta and macaroni; edible oils, including palm olein, stearin, distilled fatty acid, and others for direct and industrial uses comprising soap manufacturing; rice; and packaged foods.

BUA Foods PLC was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.
BUAFOODS.Key Executives: Ayodele Abioye (Chief Executive Officer); Ehimah Etumudon (Chief Financial Officer)

CADBURY.Description:
Cadbury Nigeria Plc engages in manufacturing and selling branded fast moving consumer goods in Nigeria.

It operates through three segments: Refreshment Beverages, Confectionery, and Intermediate Cocoa Products.

The Refreshment Beverages segment manufactures and sells Cadbury Bournvita and Cadbury 3-in-1 Hot Chocolate.

The Confectionary segment manufactures and sells Tom Tom, Candy Caramel, Buttermint, Candy Coffee, and Clorets gum products.

The Intermediate Cocoa Products segment manufactures and sells cocoa powder, cocoa butter, cocoa liquor, and cocoa cake.

It offers its products through a network of distributors, key accounts, and institutional customers, as well as chain of wholesalers and retailers.

It exports its products to various countries in Africa and Europe. Cadbury Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.

Cadbury Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of Cadbury Schweppes Overseas Limited.
CADBURY.Key Executives: Oyeyimika Adeboye (Chief Executive Officer); Victoria Akhigbe (Chief Financial Officer)

CAP.Description:
Chemical and Allied Products Plc manufactures and sells paints and coatings in Nigeria.

The company offers decorative and industrial coatings; indoor, outdoor, specialty, and protective coatings; primers; and other products.

It sells its products under the Dulux, Caplux, Sandtex, and Hempel brands. The company distributes its products through Dulux colour stores, Dulux colour shops, and Sandtex stores.

The company was founded in 1957 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria. Chemical and Allied Products Plc is a subsidiary of UAC of Nigeria PLC.
CAP.Industry: Paints, Varnishes, Lacquers, Enamels, and Allied Products
CAP.Key Executives: Zubiedat Bolarin Okunowo (Chief Executive Officer); Sulaiman Iromini (Chief Financial Officer); Jethro Iruobe (Chief Operating Officer)

CAVERTON.Description:
Caverton Offshore Support Group Plc provides marine and aviation logistics services to the oil and gas industry in Nigeria and Sub-Sahara Africa.

The company also offers charter, shuttle, and maintenance services for helicopters and airplanes; and harbor and general marine services.

In addition, it provides marine services, such as agency service, boat building, boat maintenance, and boat operations services; and training services, including training to pilots and engineers of contracting organisations.

The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. Caverton Offshore Support Group Plc is a subsidiary of Tasmania Investments Ltd.
CAVERTON.Industry: Oil and Gas Field Services, not elsewhere classified
CAVERTON.Key Executives: Olabode Makanjuola (Chief Executive Officer); Adesuntola Olusegun (Chief Financial Officer); Rotimi Makanjuola (Chief Operating Officer)

CHAMPION.Description:
Champion Breweries Plc engages in the brewing and marketing of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages in Nigeria.

It offers its products under the Champion Lager Beer, Champion Lager Beer with Ginger Extract, Champ Malta, Champ Malt with Butter Cookies Flavour, and Champ Malt with Tiger nut brands.

The company was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Uyo, Nigeria. Champion Breweries Plc operates as a subsidiary of Raysun Nigeria Limited.
CHAMPION.Key Executives: Adoga Inalegwu (Chief Executive Officer); Adebiyi Rasheed (Chief Financial Officer)

CHAMS.Description:
Chams Holding Company Plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides identity management, payment collections, and transactional systems and solutions in Nigeria.

It operates in three segments: Identity Management and Solutions; Payments, Collections and Transactional Systems; and ICT Training.

The company engages in identity management activities, including prometrics and biometrics identification with applications in the financial, healthcare, corporate, and other public fields; the sale and maintenance of Dermalog machines, fingerprint scanners, BVN machines, and data card products; and the design, print, and personalization of various types of cards products.

It also provides payments systems that involve building, developing, and maintenance of ICT infrastructures; e-payment infrastructure support to other e-payment platforms; Smart and Chip Card, a technology for card personalization, identity card enrolment logistic, and access control.

In addition, the company offers Argone, a retail service provider for the sale of phones, laptops, and accessories; PenCentral, a platform for remitting pensions; PelPay payment platform; Naira.com, which provides payment solutions; HR payroll solutions; VOTA, an e-voting platform; I’m Alive digital facial recognition service; and Kegow, a mobile money solution.

The company was formerly known as Chams Plc and changed its name to Chams Holding Company Plc in May 2022.

Chams Holding Company Plc was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.
CHAMS.Key Executives: Mayowa Olaniyan (Chief Executive Officer); Ifeoma Obasanya (Chief Financial Officer); Kayode Akomolafe (Chief Operating Officer)

CHELLARAM.Description:
Chellarams Plc engages in the trading and distribution of consumer goods, durables, ingredients, and industrial chemicals in Nigeria.

The company offers industrial raw materials, including propylene glycol, isopropanol, stearic acid, toluene, sodium laureth sulfate or sodium lauryl ether sulfate, caustic soda, ethyl acetate, mineral oil, petroleum jelly, and paraffin wax.

Its foam chemicals products, comprising TDI, polyols, silicone surfactants, amine and stannous, colour pastes, methylene chloride, kraft papers, and nylon mattress and pillow covers.

The company supplies its chemicals for sectors such as food processing, pharmaceuticals, and manufacturing.

Chellarams Plc was founded in 1923 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.
CHELLARAM.Key Executives: Aditya Chellaram (Chief Executive Officer); Rajesh Mishra (Chief Financial Officer)

CILEASING.Description:
C & I Leasing Plc provides marine services in Nigeria, Ghana, and the United Arab Emirates.

It operates through Marine, Fleet Management/ Hetrz Rent-A- Car, Outsourcing, and Citracks segments. The Marine segment offers onshore and offshore terminal services including berthing and escort, mooring, line and hose handling, pollution control, and floating and self-elevating platforms.

The Fleet Management/ Hetrz Rent-A- Car segment manages vehicles and professional chauffeurs that provides pick-up and drop-off, reservation, airport shuttle, and daily rental services under the Hertz-Rent-A car brand.

The Outsourcing segment provides manpower recruitment and development, training, business process outsourcing, e-business, personnel outsourcing, and human resource consultancy services.

The Citracks segment offers fleet management and telematics solutions. It is also involved in equipment leasing; logistics solution in the form of car and marine vessel rentals; trading in ships and boats, parts, components, and automobile; and provision of chartered vessels.

The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria. C & I Leasing Plc operates as a subsidiary of Pmt Global Investments Nigeria Limited.
CILEASING.Key Executives: Ugoji Ugoji (Chief Executive Officer); Adesoji Aiyeola (Chief Financial Officer); Babatunde Ogunturin (Chief Operating Officer)

CMFC.Description:
DEAP Capital Management & Trust Plc is a publicly owned investment manager.

The firm also provides functions of an Issuing House in the Nigerian Capital Market along with leasing and project management services to its clients.

It primarily provides its services to high net worth individuals and institutions. The firm manages separate client focused equity portfolios.

It also manages funds for its clients. The firm invests in the public equity markets.

It seeks to invest in the large cap stocks of 20 Companies listed on the Nigerian Stock Exchange. The firm makes its investments in the stocks of companies operating in the Banking, Petroleum Marketing, and Food/Beverages sectors.

It was previously known as DEAP Capital Management & Trust Limited. DEAP Capital Management & Trust Plc was founded on June 5, 2002 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria with several additional offices in Nigeria located in Abuja, Kano, Port Harcourt, Delta Sate, Owerri, Enugu, Lagos, and Abeokuta.
CMFC.Industry: Security and Commodity Brokers, Dealers, Exchanges, and Services
CMFC.Key Executives: Anthony Adigwe (Chief Executive Officer); Fenm Olaleye (Chief Financial Officer)

CONHALLPLC.Description:
Consolidated Hallmark Holdings Plc, through its subsidiaries, primarily provides insurance products and services in Nigeria.

It operates in two segments, Consolidated Hallmark Holdings Plc (CHH Plc); and Consolidated Hallmark Insurance Limited (CHI Group), Hallmark Finance Company Limited (HFC), and Hallmark Health Services Limited (HHSL).

The company provides travel, marine, oil and gas, motor comprehensive, machinery breakdown, contractors-all-risk, motor 3rd party fire and theft, money, plant-all-risk, home, bonds, burglary, consequential loss, personal accident, fire and special perils, professional indemnity, aviation, combined fire and burglary, enhanced motor third party, and goods-in-transit insurance products.

It also engages in the general insurance, finance company, and health management organization (HMO) businesses.

In addition, the company offers loans and finance to individual, SMEs, and corporate entities. Consolidated Hallmark Holdings Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
CONHALLPLC.Key Executives: Eddie Efekoha (Chief Executive Officer); Babatunde Daramola (Chief Financial Officer)

CONOIL.Description:
Conoil Plc markets refined petroleum products, and manufactures and markets lubricants, household, and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) in Nigeria.

The company operates through three segments: White Products, Lubricants, and Liquefied Petroleum Gas.

Its White Products segment sells premium motor spirit, aviation turbine kerosene, dual-purpose kerosene, low-pour fuel oil, and automotive gasoline/grease oil.

The Lubricants segment offers transport and industrial lubricants, greases, process oil, and bitumen.

Its LPG segment is involved in the trading of bulk and packed LPG, cylinders, and valves. The company was formerly known as National Oil and Chemical Marketing Plc and changed its name to Conoil Plc in January 2003.

Conoil Plc was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. Conoil Plc is a subsidiary of Conpetro Limited.
CONOIL.Key Executives: Mike Oraekwuotu (Chief Executive Officer); Salam Ajani (Chief Financial Officer)

CORNERST.Description:
Cornerstone Insurance Plc, together with its subsidiaries, offers risk underwriting and related financial services for corporate and individual customers in Nigeria.

The company operates through Non-Life Insurance, Life Insurance, Takaful Insurance, Fin Insurance, Leasing, and Life Deposit Administration/Investment Contracts.

It also offers property-casualty and life/health insurance products. In addition, it provides motor vehicle, aviation, marine, engineering all risks, asset protection, children education fund, liability to third party, oil and gas, group life, credit life, endowment, funeral expenses policy, mortgage protection, term assurance, Takaful, fire and burglary, general accident, bond, goods in transit, home, personal accident, and travel insurance products.

Further, the company offers leasing services; and investment products. Cornerstone Insurance Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
CORNERST.Key Executives: Stephen Alangbor (Chief Executive Officer); Jubril Ajose (Chief Financial Officer); Peter Ekwueme (Chief Operating Officer)

CUSTODIAN.Description:
Custodian Investment Plc, through its subsidiaries, provides insurance products and services in Nigeria.

It operates through Non-Life Business, Life Business, Pension Administration, Property Development and Management, and Trustees and Others segments.

The Non-Life Business segment offers engineering, aviation, marine and motor liability, oil and energy, fire, and property insurance for individual and corporate customers.

The Life Business segment provides a range of life insurance products for individual and group, including annuity, endowment and investment-oriented products, and insurance products with discretionary participatory features (DPF).

The Pension Administration segment is involved in the administration and management of the retirement benefits of members.

The Property Development and Management segment engages in the acquisition, development, sale, and management of various commercial, residential, hospitality, and retail property assets.

The Trustees and Others segment includes trustee management, corporate services, investment, and property management.

The company offers general insurance products, such as auto, travel, home, event, personal accident, and other insurance products; and life insurance products, including savings and investment, endowment, protection, annuity, and other products, as well as group life and group credit life insurance products.

The company was formerly known as Custodian and Allied Insurance Limited. Custodian Investment Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
CUSTODIAN.Key Executives: Oluwole Oshin (Chief Executive Officer); Ademola Ajuwon (Chief Financial Officer); Adeniyi Falade (Chief Operating Officer); Ademola Ajuwon (Head of Investor Relations)

CUTIX.Description:
Cutix Plc manufactures, markets, and sells electrical, automobile, and telecommunication wires, cables, and related products in Nigeria.

The company offers house wiring cables, such as PVC insulated, PVC sheathed, single solid, single stranded, aluminium service cables, bare conductors, flexible cables, and low voltage power cables; industrial power cables, comprising armored and non- armored; and round cables.

Cutix Plc was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Otolo, Nigeria.
CUTIX.Industry: Drawing and Insulating of Nonferrous Wire
CUTIX.Key Executives: Uchechukwu Igbokwe (Chief Executive Officer); Uche Okonkwo (Chief Financial Officer); Chidinma Maduekwe (Chief Operating Officer)

CWG.Description:
CWG Plc engages in the supply, installation, integration, maintenance, and support of computer equipment, e-payment hardware, and ancillary equipment in Nigeria, Ghana, Uganda, and Cameroon.

It operates through IT Infrastructure, Communication and Integrated Services, Managed Support Services, Software, and Platform segments.

The IT Infrastructure segment supplies, installs, and supports computer hardware; and operates middleware systems and automated teller machines.

The Communication and Integrated Services segment offer VSAT and fiber connectivity, metropolitan, wide, local area networks, and systems integration, as well as network communications support services.

The Managed Support Services segment provides internal and external clients managed/outsourcing services, and related accessories for equipment and service maintenance.

The Software segment offers services in software deployment, implementation and support, systems analysis, design and implementation, and smartcard applications, as well as training to clients on the systems and other off-the-shelf packages.

The Platform segment provides products and solutions as the foundation for growth and progress in e-commerce and society, such as BillsNPay, SMERP, UCP, and Finedge.

The company was formerly known as Computer Warehouse Group Plc. CWG Plc was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
CWG.Industry: Computer Programming, Data Processing, And Other Computer Related Services
CWG.Key Executives: Adewale Adeyipo (Chief Executive Officer); Afolabi Sobande (Chief Operating Officer)

DAARCOMM.Description:
Daar Communications Plc operates as a media and entertainment company in Nigeria and internationally.

It operates through Raypower FM, AIT / Television, and DAAR News segments. The company broadcasts television channels comprising news channels, such as AIT News, AIT News Hour, World News, AIT Reports, and The Week in Review; current affairs, including Kaakaki, Focus Nigeria, Inside The Parliament, Democracy Today, Global Views Africa, and Security Watch; public enlightenment, such as AIT Infotech Network and Policy on Trac; business comprising Money Line, Global Business, and Business Africa; musicals, such as One Mic, Shakatawa, Gbedu on the Move, Prime Time Africa, Musical Concerts – specials, and AIT Music Plus; sports, including Sports Extra, Sports Today, and Sports File; Magazine/Talk Shows comprising The Amazons and Bisi Olatilo Show (BOS); cultural, such as Mini Jojo & Oro to no – Yoruba Language, Yakpotuba – Igbo Language, Ido – Hausa Language, and Enjoyment Yafun Yafun – Pidgin English; and Tourism, including Goge Africa.

It also operates AIT INT’L, an English language general entertainment channel showing predominantly news, sports, current affairs, movies, drama, and soap programmes of African origin; and AIT Sport that provides national sports coverage for AIT Television, radio, and online.

In addition, the company Raypower 100.5 FM, a radio station that promotes news, current affairs, politics, business, sports, health, gender matters, youths and children, environment, culture, religion, and lifestyle.

Daar Communications Plc was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Abuja, Nigeria. Daar Communications Plc is a subsidiary of DAAR Investment & Holding Co. Ltd.
DAARCOMM.Key Executives: Marcellinus Anyalechi (Chief Executive Officer); Stanley Sagboje (Chief Financial Officer)

DANGCEM.Description:
Dangote Cement Plc, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the preparation, manufacturing, distribution, and sale of cement and related products in Nigeria.

The company is involved in manufacturing, bagging, grinding, distribution, and sale of cement; limestone mining; holding of other mining rights; selling and distribution of fuels; coal and power production activities; property investment activities; and manufacturing of ceramic products, as well as providing contracting services.

It has operations in Nigeria, Ghana, South Africa, Ethiopia, Zambia, Tanzania, Senegal, Cameroon, Cote D'Ivoire, and Congo.

The company was formerly known as Obajana Cement Plc and changed its name to Dangote Cement Plc in July 2010.

The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. Dangote Cement Plc operates as a subsidiary of Dangote Industries Limited.
DANGCEM.Key Executives: Arvind Pathak (Chief Executive Officer); Gbenga Fapohunda (Chief Financial Officer); Michael Ani (Head of Investor Relations)

DANGSUGAR.Description:
Dangote Sugar Refinery Plc produces and sells refined sugar to consumers and industrial markets in Nigeria.

The company offers vitamin A fortified sugar for direct consumption, baked foods, sweetening of cereals, and beverages applications; and non-fortified industrial sugar used by pharmaceuticals, food and beverage, other manufacturing companies.

It sells its products under the Dangote Sugar brands. The company also exports its products.

The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. Dangote Sugar Refinery Plc operates as a subsidiary of Dangote Industries Limited.
DANGSUGAR.Key Executives: Thabo Mabe (Chief Executive Officer); Isiaka Bello (Chief Financial Officer); Mariya Dangote (Chief Operating Officer)

EKOCORP.Description:
EkoCorp Plc provides healthcare services in Nigeria.

It provides outpatients nursing, capitation, intensive care unit, medical, pediatric, obstetrics and gynecology, radiology, surgery, and general services.

It serves private, corporate, and health maintenance organizations. The company was formerly known as Eko Hospital Limited and changed its name to EkoCorp Plc in January 1995.

EkoCorp Plc was founded in 1977 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.

ENAMELWA.Description:

The company also imports and sells bulk petroleum products, such as premium motor spirit, automotive gas oil, aviation turbine fuel, and base oils.

In addition, it provides bunkering; gas distribution; liquefied petroleum gas and natural gas marketing; offshore and onshore oil; and gas processing services, as well as trades in crude oil and other refined petroleum products.

ETI.Description:
Ecobank Transnational Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, provides retail, corporate, and investment banking services in Nigeria and rest of Africa.

It operates through Corporate & Investment Banking, Commercial Banking, and Consumer Banking segments.

The company offers current and savings accounts, and term deposits; debit, credit, and prepaid cards; personal, mortgage, travel, and cash backed loans, as well as auto loan/asset acquisition, salary advance, and advance facility products; transfer and payment, and foreign exchange services; microfinance; investment solutions comprising fixed income funds; and bancassurance products.

ETRANZACT.Description:
eTranzact International Plc, a payment technology provider, engages in the processing of various types of electronic payment transactions using its switching platform worldwide.

It operates through Mobile; Other Commissions; and Maintenance and Support Services, Software Development and Others segments.

The company's switching platform processes transactions across various channels, such as mobile phones, web, point of sale, automated teller machines, other mobile devices, and bank branches.

It also offers Bankit, an omni-channel direct to bank payment gateway; PocketMoni, a wallet and payment platform; WebConnect, a payment gateway for direct payment with bank accounts; and Payoutlet.net to pay bills, send money, and top-up mobile phones.

In addition, the company provides SwitchIt, which validates, processes, and authorizes transactions; CorporatePay, an online platform for bulk payments; Payoutlet, a collection platform across its member banks’ branches; and Credo, a social payment platform for businesses.

Further, it offers software development and maintenance services. The company serves individuals, corporates, and institutions.

EUNISELL.Description:
Eunisell Interlinked Plc develops, manufactures, and markets various polymeric, porcelain, and metallic products in Nigeria.

It also markets and sells high and low voltage electrical cables and cable accessories, umbilical cables and accessories, various telecommunications cable accessories, and fibre optics accessories, as well as forms of bearings, pumps, and cable closures.

The company sells and installs transformers; undertakes engineering, procurement, and construction services contracts; and engages in power generations installation.

Further, it provides installation and commissioning; repairs, operations and maintenance; power asset development and reliability; high voltage electrical services; energy and project management; technical services and audit; thermal control; subsea power systems; engineering procurement construction; and renewable energy services.

Additionally, the company offers connectors and fittings; jointing and termination kits; timken bearings; and other products.

FCMB.Description:
FCMB Group Plc provides various banking and financial services in Nigeria and Europe.

The company offers micro-lending, asset management, stock-broking, trusteeship and custodial services, foreign exchange, personal banking, and corporate and commercial banking services.

It also provides investment banking services, including financial advisory, debt and equity capital markets, and project and structured finance transactions; and transaction banking products, delivering cash management; and trade and liquidity management solutions.

The company serves corporate, commercial, public sector, financial institutions, and small and medium-scale enterprises.

FCMB Group Plc was founded in 1977 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.

FIDELITYBK.Description:
Fidelity Bank Plc provides various banking products and services to corporate and individual customers in Nigeria.

It operates through Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, and Investment Banking segments. The company offers current, savings, fixed deposit, domiciliary, term deposit, flex, bridge, vintage, and small business accounts; asset leasing, personal loans and mortgages, fast loans, and salary advance schemes; bills settlement, and cash and asset management services; treasury bills, fixed income securities, and foreign exchange and derivatives, and safe deposit keeping services; and advisory, insurance, investment management, estate planning, wire transfer, and tax planning services.

FIDSON.Description:
Fidson Healthcare Plc manufactures and distributes pharmaceutical products in Nigeria.

The company operates in three segments: Over-the-Counter, Ethical Products, and Consumer Healthcare Product.

It offers drugs, infusions, capsules, syrups, tablets, and injectables. The company also provides products for anti-infective and anti-malaria, central nervous system, and cough and cold, gastrointestinal medicines; supplements; topical/dermatological medicines; vitamins and minerals; and ophthalmic solutions.

Fidson Healthcare Plc was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.

FIRSTHOLDCO.Description:
First HoldCo Plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides commercial banking, investment banking, corporate banking, and other financial services in Nigeria and internationally.

The company operates through the Commercial Banking Business Group; Investment Banking and Asset Management Business Group (IBAM); and Others segments.

The Commercial Banking Business Group segment offers financial intermediation services to individual, and corporate clients/customers.

The IBAM segment provides advisory, asset management, markets, and private equity services to corporations and governments; and merchant banking services.

The Others segment offers insurance brokerage services. The company also provides funds management, investment and general trading, trusteeship, real estate investment, financial/ investment advisory, investment banking and funds, and portfolio management services.

In addition, it is involved in the venture capital and private equity business. Further, the company offers retail portfolios, such as credit cards, mortgages, term loans, and overdraft facilities.

FTGINSURE.Description:

FTNCOCOA.Description:

GOLDBREW.Description:

The company operates through six segments: Corporate Banking, Commercial Banking, Business Banking, Retail Banking, SME Banking, and Public Sector.

The company offers current accounts, savings deposits, and investment savings products; overdrafts, loans, and other credit facilities; and foreign currency and derivative products.

It also provides private banking and custody services, credit and debit cards, and consumer loans and mortgages.

The company serves corporate customers and blue chips; mid-size and fledgling corporate customers; mid-size commercial customers; small and medium-size enterprises and ventures; and government ministries, departments, and agencies.

GUINEAINS.Description:
Guinea Insurance Plc provides general insurance products and services to individuals and corporate organizations in Nigeria.

The company operates through Motor, Marine and Aviation, General Accident, and Fire segments. It offers personal and business, including agricultural, travel, oil and gas, and fire and special perils insurances.

HBMNG.Description:
HBM Nigeria Plc, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, and sells cement and other cementitious products in Nigeria.

It offers aggregates, ready-mix concrete, fly-ash, cementitious tile adhesive, plaster of Paris (POP), and power generation products, as well as mortar and waste management solutions.

HONYFLOUR.Description:

IMG.Description:

In addition, the company is involved in mining leases for gold, lead, zinc, lithium, and copper. Further, it engages in platform support vessels, anchor handling tug supply vessels, offshore support vessels, and oil tankers related businesses.

JBERGER.Description:
Julius Berger Nigeria Plc engages in the planning and construction of various civil engineering works in Nigeria and Europe.

The company operates through four segments: Civil Works, Building Works, Services, and Diversification.

The Civil Works segment provides professional services in the areas of engineering, construction, and maintenance of various infrastructures, including construction of traffic networks, turnkey harbors, wharfs, jetties, loading installations, and warehouses; refurbishment and construction of airports; design and construction of auxiliary buildings for factories, oil and gas installations, and power plants in the oil, gas, and energy sectors.

Livingtrust Mortgage Bank PLC provides residential and commercial mortgage financing services in Nigeria.

In addition, the company is involved in venture capital projects; acting as an investment and portfolio manager, an executor and trustee of wills and trusts, and promoter of unit trust and funds; administrating and managing pension fund assets; providing general corporate finance and debt advisory services; and agency, stockbroking, and insurance brokerage services.

The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria. Stanbic IBTC Holdings PLC is a subsidiary of Stanbic Africa Holdings Limited.
STANBIC.Industry: Security Brokers, Dealers, and Flotation Companies
STANBIC.Key Executives: Chukwuma Nwokocha (Chief Executive Officer); Adekunle Adedeji (Chief Financial Officer); Remilekun Ishola (Head of Investor Relations)

STERLINGNG.Description:
Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc provides various commercial banking products and services primarily to multinational companies, financial institutions, individuals, small businesses, partnerships, and commercial entities in Nigeria.

It operates through Retail Banking, Commercial Banking, Institutional Banking, Corporate & Investment Banking, Non-Interest Banking, and Special Purpose Vehicle segments.

The company offers savings and current accounts; investment products; personal loans; cards; e-channels; business accounts, loan products, business advisory and business digital solutions for SMEs; credit services to large scale enterprises; recurring, discounted certificate, fixed, and call deposits; and importers financing, invoice discount facility, letter of credit, and overdraft services.

The company offers retail and consumer banking, and trade services; corporate, investment, non-interest banking and asset management services; and wholesale banking services comprising the granting of loans and advances, letter of credit transactions, money market operations, electronic and mobile banking products, and other banking activities, as well as issues debt securities to borrow funds and solutions, and guided by Islamic economics.

It operates a network of branches and cash centers. Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
STERLINGNG.Key Executives: Yemi Odubiyi (Chief Executive Officer); Adebimpe Olambiwonnu (Chief Financial Officer)

SUNUASSUR.Description:
Sunu Assurances Nigeria Plc provides non-life insurance products in Nigeria.

The company operates through three segments: Non-Life Insurance, Asset Management, and Health Management.

It offers burglary, computer all risks, householders/house owner, motor, and personal accident insurance products for individual clients.

The company also provides aviation, boiler, builder’s liability, burglary, contractors all risks, director and officers liability, employers liability, fidelity guarantee, fire and special perils, general accident–automobile contingent liability, group personal accident, marine, money, motor, professional indemnity, and public liability insurance products for corporate clients.

In addition, it offers health and asset management, and hospitality services. The company was formerly known as Equity Assurance Plc.

The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. Sunu Assurances Nigeria Plc operates as a subsidiary of Sunu Participations Holding S.A.
SUNUASSUR.Key Executives: Samuel Ogbodu (Chief Executive Officer); Olusegun Oginni (Chief Financial Officer)

TANTALIZER.Description:
Tantalizers PLC provides quick service restaurant and outdoor catering services in Nigeria.

The company offers bread, breakfast, burgers, drinks, proteins, snacks/pastries, soups, Africana meals, and tantis cakes.

It also franchises its restaurants. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.
TANTALIZER.Industry: Canned, Frozen, And Preserved Fruits, Vegetables, and Food Specialties
TANTALIZER.Key Executives: Robert Speijer (Chief Executive Officer); Bamidele Oke (Chief Financial Officer); Olusegun Ekundayo (Chief Operating Officer)

THOMASWY.Description:
Thomas Wyatt Nigeria Plc engages in the manufacture, marketing, and sale of paper products in Nigeria.

The company provides exercise books, hard cover notebooks, soft cover note pads, school and office stationery, drawing books, envelopes, ruled papers, duplicated books, spiral and quarter bound books, and photocopying and typing papers.

It is also involved in the marketing of office equipment and writing materials. The company was formerly known as Thomas Wyatt and Son (West Africa) Limited.

Thomas Wyatt Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
THOMASWY.Industry: Converted Paper And Paperboard Products, Except Containers And Boxes

TIP.Description:
The Initiates Plc provides waste management, industrial cleaning, and decontamination services.

The company offers thermal destruction services for the destruction of chemical waste, medical waste, and other hazardous waste; decontamination, removal, and disposal services for asbestos and asbestos containing materials; waste water treatment systems; E-waste processing services comprising ODS reclamation, data destruction, screens, and cable/batteries recycling; and thermal desorption services for the treatment of drill cuttings, hydrocarbon contaminated soil, and oily sludge.

It also provides tank/FPSO/FSO-sludge evacuation services; tanks and vessels, boiler, and heat exchangers cleaning services; jetting and surface preparation services for industrial and commercial facilities; and pipe and drainage cleaning services.

The Initiates Plc was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Port Harcourt, Nigeria.
TIP.Key Executives: Reuben Ossai (Chief Executive Officer); Rosemary Taneh (Chief Financial Officer)

TOTAL.Description:
TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc markets and distributes refined petroleum and solar products in Nigeria.

It operates through Network, General Trade, and Aviation segments. The company offers premium motor spirit (PMS), automotive gasoline oil (AGO), and aviation turbine kerosene (ATK), as well as kerosene for use in lamps, cooking stoves, etc. It also provides range of lubricants, such as industrial and automotive lubricants; engine oils for cars, motorcycles, tricycles, and heavy-duty engines; transmission oils and brake fluids; marine oils; and automotive and industrial greases under the TotalEnergies and ELF brand names.

In addition, the company jet fuels and aviation gasolines for the aviation industry; bitumen; and solar lamps, and solar home and industrial solutions.

Further, it operates service stations and lubricants blending plants; provides food, snacks, and coffee products through Café Bonjour; and offers TotalEnergies Card for individuals and professionals, as well as offers TouchPoint services to facilitate the management of mobile money services and other digital services.

The company was formerly known as Total Nigeria Plc and changed its name to TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc in September 2021.

TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of TotalEnergies Marketing & Services.
TOTAL.Key Executives: Wilfried Konde (Chief Executive Officer); Samson Eghwerehe (Chief Financial Officer)

TRANSCOHOT.Description:
Transcorp Hotels Plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides hospitality services in Nigeria.

The company’s hotel services include accommodation, fine dining, equipped meeting rooms, as well as conference and leisure facilities to business travelers and tourists.

It operates the Transcorp Hilton and Transcorp Centre hotel located in Abuja; and Aura by Transcorp Hotels.

The company was formerly known as Transnational Hotels and Tourism Services Limited and changed its name to Transcorp Hotels Plc in 2014.

The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Abuja, Nigeria. Transcorp Hotels Plc is a subsidiary of Transnational Corporation of Nigeria Plc.
TRANSCOHOT.Key Executives: Uzoamaka Oshogwe (Chief Executive Officer); Oluwatobiloba Ojediran (Chief Financial Officer); Segun Oduwole (Chief Operating Officer); Oluwatobiloba Ojediran (Head of Investor Relations)

TRANSCORP.Description:
Transnational Corporation Plc, together with the subsidiaries, engages in the power, oil and gas, and hospitality businesses in Nigeria.

It operates through five operating segments: Hospitality, Agro-allied, Power, Oil & Gas, and Corporate Centre.

The company owns and operates Transcorp Hilton Abuja and Aura by Transcorp Hotels, a digital hospitality platform; and provides hospitality services.

It is also involved in the exploration, refining, and marketing of petroleum products, and oil and gas; general maritime marketing; growing agricultural products; processing of food and cash crops activities; and generation and sale of electric power.

In addition, the company provides communication services. Transnational Corporation Plc was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.
TRANSCORP.Industry: Cogeneration Services and Small Power Producers
TRANSCORP.Key Executives: Owen Omogiafo (Chief Executive Officer); Festus Izevbizua (Chief Financial Officer); Festus Izevbizua (Head of Investor Relations)

TRANSEXPR.Description:
Trans-Nationwide Express Plc, a logistics company, provides express delivery, haulage, freight, and other ancillary transportation and storage services in Nigeria.

The company offers logistics services; sea and air freight; storage facilities at its warehouses; e-commerce/order fulfillment services for online procurement; transportation of sensitive medical and pharmaceutical shipments; haulage and transportation services; and packaging, labelling, and removal solutions for corporate and personal needs.

It also provides mailroom management services and courier services. The company was formerly known as TNT Skypak Nigeria Limited and changed its name to Trans-Nationwide Express Plc in 1992.

Trans-Nationwide Express Plc was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
TRANSEXPR.Industry: Arrangement of Transportation of Freight and Cargo
TRANSEXPR.Key Executives: Eric Emecheta (Chief Executive Officer); Vincent Ihemenwa (Chief Financial Officer)

TRANSPOWER.Description:
Transcorp Power Plc engages in the generation and sale of electric power in Nigeria and internationally.

It operates a gas-fired open cycle thermal power plant with an installed capacity of 972 MW. The company was formerly known as Transcorp Power Limited and changed its name to Transcorp Power Plc in January 2024.

Transcorp Power Plc was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria. Transcorp Power Plc is a subsidiary of Transnational Corporation of Nigeria Plc.
TRANSPOWER.Key Executives: Peter Ikenga (Chief Executive Officer); Evans Okpogoro (Chief Financial Officer); Aniebiet Umoh (Chief Operating Officer)

TRIPPLEG.Description:
Tripple Gee & Company Plc engages in the production and sale of security documents, financial instruments, and flexible packaging items in Nigeria.

The company offers MICR encoded and personalized cheques; election stationery; share certificates; licenses and permits; custom revenue forms and receipts; tax clearance certificates and land documentation; and utility bills and financial statement documents for commercial banks, central and state governments, electoral commissions, tax and revenue authorities, regulatory bodies, utility providers, and large corporations.

It also provides packaging products, such as tea tags, food and drink products, oil lubricant labels, pharma labels, anti-counterfeit labels, larger format packaging labels, as well as nylon, bioxially oriented poly propylene, PVC, and shrink; and pouches and sachets, wraps and roll stocks, shrink sleeves, and specialty labels and tags for food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and personal care, oil and gas, and agro-allied and industrial goods industries.

In addition, the company offers tru-DATA, a solution that offers an encryption technology for identification, verification, and protection.

Tripple Gee & Company Plc was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.
TRIPPLEG.Key Executives: Adebimpe Giwa (Chief Executive Officer); Ibrahim Akintan (Chief Financial Officer)

UACN.Description:
UAC of Nigeria PLC operates in the animal feeds and other edibles, paints, packaged food and beverages, and quick service restaurant business in Nigeria and internationally.

The company engages in the manufacture and sale of livestock feeds and edible oil; paint products and other decoratives; and fruit juices, still drinks, dairy products, bottled water, and snacks and ice cream.

It is also involved in the making and sale of snacks and meals. It also engages in property development; building and operation maintenance for commercial and residential properties; operation of hotel and conference rooms and banquet halls; and provision of logistics services, such as warehousing, short-and medium-haul transportation, and haulage services.

The company operates and franchises Mr Biggs’ and Debonairs Pizza chain of restaurants.UAC of Nigeria PLC was founded in 1879 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.

UACN.Key Executives: Folasope Aiyesimoju (Chief Executive Officer); Babafunke Ijaiya-Oladipo (Chief Financial Officer); Nneka Chime (Chief Operating Officer)

UBA.Description:
United Bank for Africa Plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides corporate, commercial, and retail banking services in Nigeria, Africa, and internationally.

The company operates through Corporate Banking, Retail/Commercial Banking, and Treasury and Financial Markets segments.

It offers savings, current, salary, domiciliary, diaspora, and fixed deposit accounts, and UBA SME account, as well as asset-backed; solar financing; personal; senior citizens; SME green financing; and micro business loans.

It also provides corporate banking financial solutions to multinationals, regional companies, state-owned companies, non-governmental organizations, international and multinational organizations, and financial institutions; retail/commercial banking products and services to middle and retail segments; and financing and risk management solutions, and advisory services to corporate and institutional customers.

In addition, it offers energy banking services, including treasury products; current/dom. services; credit facilities, including LPO financing, IDC, bonds, guarantees, and export; credit, agency backed financing solutions, note issuance facilities, FCY lending and hedging products; structured/project finance; loan syndication; E–banking services; auto notification services; card-based services; government payment and collection services; and in plant tellering services.

Further, it provides mobile, Internet, and magic banking, as well as notification services; SME loans and advances, including working capital loans, SME asset finance, healthcare loans, creative industry finance, young entrepreneurs loans, and school loans, as well as SME accounts; business registration support services; international trade services; card solutions; merchant services; strategic advisory and research; and e-payment solutions.

It offers trade, remittance, treasury management, custody, and cash management services. The company was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
UBA.Key Executives: Oliver Alawuba (Chief Executive Officer); Ugochukwu Nwaghodoh (Chief Financial Officer)

UCAP.Description:
United Capital Plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides investment banking, portfolio management, securities trading, and trusteeship services in Nigeria.

It operates through Investment Banking, Asset Management, Pan Africa, UCAP Asset Management West Africa, Wealth Management, Trustees, Securities Trading, Consumer Finance, and UCEE Microfinance Bank segments.

The company offers issuing house, corporate investment advisory, project finance, debt restructuring, mergers and acquisitions, asset management, wealth management, and debt capital market services.

It also provides trust services, such as debenture trust; bond trusteeship to corporate and sub-sovereign issuers of public debt instruments; trustees to collective investment schemes; and private and security trusts.

In addition, the company offers stockbroking, consumer lending, and financing services. It serves governments; micro, small, and medium scale enterprises; institutions; high net worth individuals; and other individuals.

The company was formerly known as UBA Capital PLC and changed its name to United Capital Plc in December 2014.

United Capital Plc was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
UCAP.Industry: Security and Commodity Brokers, Dealers, Exchanges, and Services

UNILEVER.Description:
Unilever Nigeria Plc manufactures and markets food, home care, and beauty and personal care products primarily in Nigeria and internationally.

It operates through Food, Beauty & Wellbeing, and Personal Care segments. The company offers products under the Close-Up, Pepsodent, Vaseline, Rexona, Royco and Pears, Knorr, and Royco brand names.

Unilever Nigeria Plc was formerly known as Lever Brothers (West Africa), Ltd. and changed its name to Unilever Nigeria Plc in 2001.

The company was incorporated in 1923 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria. Unilever Nigeria Plc operates as a subsidiary of Unilever PLC.
UNILEVER.Industry: Soap, Detergents, And Cleaning Preparations; Perfumes, Cosmetics, and Other Toilet Preparations
UNILEVER.Key Executives: Tobi Adeniyi (Chief Executive Officer); Folake Ogundip (Chief Financial Officer)

UNIONDICON.Description:
Union Dicon Salt Plc engages in the processing of crude salt in Nigeria.

It sells pure, refined, and iodized edible salts, as well as offers transportation and product testing services.

Union Dicon Salt Plc was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.

UNITYBNK.Description:
As of June 26, 2026, Unity Bank Plc was acquired by Providus Bank Limited.

Unity Bank Plc provides banking and other financial services to corporate and individual customers in Nigeria.

The company accepts current, savings, and fixed deposit accounts; grants loans and advances; and offers consumer and trade finance, international banking, cash management, mobile and electronic banking services, and money market services.

It also provides asset acquisition finance, salary advance, and salary backed loans; bills payment, funds transfer, domiciliary transfer, airtime purchase, money transfer, foreign exchange, treasury bills and bonds, and cards.

In addition, the company offers business banking services, including inventory finance, letter of credit, and overdraft facility; unity farmers co-operative leasing and finance scheme, and unity industrial input farmers schemes; and fixed income, bankers’ acceptance, and commercial papers products.

Unity Bank Plc was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
UNITYBNK.Key Executives: Ebenezer Kolawole (Chief Executive Officer); Ebenezer Kolawole (Chief Financial Officer); Zubairu Atiku (Chief Operating Officer)

UNIVINSURE.Description:
Universal Insurance Plc provides risk underwriting, related financial, and hospitality services in Nigeria.

It offers all risks, auto, boiler and pressure vessels, bond, builders and employers’ liability, burglary and house breaking, agricultural, fidelity guarantee, fire and special perils, goods in transit, group personal accident, health care professional indemnity, machinery breakdown, marine cargo, marine hull and machinery, money policies, occupiers' liability, oil and gas, and professional indemnity insurance products, as well as contractors, erection, and plant all risks insurance.

The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
UNIVINSURE.Key Executives: Japhet Duru (Chief Executive Officer); Doris Ekeopara (Chief Financial Officer)

UPDC.Description:
UPDC Plc, together with its subsidiaries, develops, sells, and manages real estate assets in Nigeria.

The company operates in two segments, Property Development, Sales & Management; and Hospitality Services.

It acquires, develops, sells, leases, and manages commercial and residential accommodation properties and retail spaces, as well as offers advisory services.

The company also provides facilities management services to residential and commercial properties; and hotel management services, such as sale of rooms and conference halls, as well as food and beverages.

The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria. UPDC Plc is a subsidiary of Custodian Investment Plc.
UPDC.Key Executives: Odunayo Ojo (Chief Executive Officer); Francis Falola (Chief Financial Officer)

UPDCREIT.Description:
UPDC Real Estate Investment Trust is a real estate investment trust.

It invests in the real estate markets across Nigeria. UPDC Real Estate Investment Trust was formed on June 6, 2013 and is based in Nigeria.

UPDC Real Estate Investment Trust operates as a subsidiary of FSDH Asset Management Limited.
UPDCREIT.Key Executives: Busola Jejelowo (Chief Executive Officer); Olaleye Kolawole (Chief Financial Officer)

UPL.Description:
University Press Plc engages in the printing, publishing, sale, and distribution of educational and general reading books and materials in Nigeria and internationally.

It offers books for pre-primary, primary, junior and senior secondary, and tertiary curriculum titles.

The company also provides books on general interest, including dictionaries, world bank, special publications, and lang and culture books.

University Press Plc was founded in 1949 and is based in Ibadan, Nigeria.
UPL.Key Executives: Samuel Kolawole (Chief Executive Officer); Ganiyu Adebayo (Chief Financial Officer)

VERITASKAP.Description:
Veritas Kapital Assurance Plc provides non-life insurance products and services to individuals and businesses in Nigeria.

It operates through Non-Life Business, Pension Administration, and Health Care segments. The company offers fire and special perils, motor, bond, aviation, marine, oil and gas, energy, property, agriculture, personal and group accidents, household, third party, travel, workmen’s compensation, construction, health, and other insurance products.

It also provides engineering insurance products, including contractor’s and erection all risks insurance policies, as well as machinery breakdown insurance.

In addition, it is involved in the administration and management of pension fund assets. The company was formerly known as UnityKapital Assurance Plc changed its name to Veritas Kapital Assurance Plc in April 2018.

The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Abuja, Nigeria. Veritas Kapital Assurance Plc is a subsidiary of Veritas Capital Limited.
VERITASKAP.Key Executives: Adaobi Nwakuche (Chief Executive Officer); Somorin Mojeed Gbolagade (Chief Financial Officer); Sunkanmi Adekeye (Chief Operating Officer)

VFDGROUP.Description:
VFD Group PLC, a proprietary investment company, provides alternative funding and investment channels accessible to individuals, small businesses, and operators in Nigeria and Ghana.

The company engages in microfinance banking, investment and fund management, issuing house and investment adviser, stock and insurance brokerage, auto and financial leasing, real estate and hospitality development, logistics and haulage, lending and technology, IT infrastructure development, digital product development, building construction services, comfort-food style restaurant, relaxation, leisure and homestyle cooking’s activities.

It offers its services to the financial services, capital market, technology, security services, banking, remittance, real estate and hospitality, leasing, media and entertainment, infrastructure, and energy sectors.

VFD Group PLC was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
VFDGROUP.Key Executives: Nonso Okpala (Chief Executive Officer); Raphael Olope (Chief Financial Officer); Morenike Ominike (Chief Operating Officer)

VITAFOAM.Description:
Vitafoam Nigeria Plc, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture, marketing, and distribution of flexible and rigid foam, fibre products, and textile linens in Nigeria and other West African countries.

It operates through two segments, Foam Products and Furniture/Other Products. The company provides inner core spring mattresses; regular flexible foams; fibre-based and allied products; rigid foam; and visco-elastic foam products.

It also offers wood and metal furniture products, and oil filters, as well as engages in the system house projects.

The company serves real estate, healthcare, hospitality, oil and gas, automotive, and agricultural sectors.

Vitafoam Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.
VITAFOAM.Key Executives: Taiwo Adeniyi (Chief Executive Officer); Joseph Alegbesogie (Chief Financial Officer)

WAPIC.Description:
Coronation Insurance Plc, through its subsidiaries, engages in underwriting of life and non-life insurance for individuals and corporate entities.

It operates in two segments, General Business and Life Business. The company offers current, escrow, joint, and domiciliary accounts; home, personal accident, car, travel, life, liability, marine, business vehicle, buildings and contents, construction, business interruption, group welfare and life, and bancassurance insurance products; asset management, such as fixed income, private equity, equities, trust services, mutual funds, alternatives, and advisory services; and estate planning, trustee, registrar, and data management services.

It also provides treasury management products, such as liquidity management, treasury bills, local and foreign currency, term deposits, commercial papers and notes, trading, and global currency; yacht and aviation financing, and emergency loans; investment banking products, including corporate restructuring, project finance, mergers and acquisitions, and capital raising; and wealth management products, such as financial planning, retirement planning, and managed portfolio.

In addition, it offers securities trading and brokerage services, such as investment advisory, repo, brokerage accounts, equities, and margin loans; and venture building and capital under technology services.

It was formerly known as Wapic Insurance Plc and changed its name to Coronation Insurance Plc in September 2020.

The company was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
WAPIC.Key Executives: Olamide Olajolo (Chief Executive Officer); Joshua Ojumoro (Chief Financial Officer)

WEMABANK.Description:
Wema Bank PLC provides banking and other financial services to corporate and individual customers in Nigeria.

The company offers current and saving accounts, HNIs, and fixed deposits; card services, such as debit, credit, and prepaid cards; consumer and personal loans, and revolving overdrafts; and collection services.

It also provides corporate banking services, including overdraft, term loan, import and trade finance, and financial lease facilities; and agricultural finance, as well as export, power, oil and gas, maritime, and concessionary finance services.

In addition, the company offers small and medium scale enterprise financial advisory services; retail management and integrated revenue services; as well as cards, and electronic and internet banking services.

The company was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.
WEMABANK.Key Executives: Moruf Oseni (Chief Executive Officer); Bunmi Oladosu (Chief Financial Officer); Tajudeen Bakare (Chief Operating Officer)

ZENITHBANK.Description:
Zenith Bank Plc provides banking and other financial services to corporate and individual customers in Nigeria, rest of Africa, and internationally.

It accepts current, savings, salary, domiciliary, and children’s accounts; fixed and call deposits, certificate of deposits, and short-term investment funds; sole proprietorship and partnership accounts, and trust funds; clubs, societies, and associations accounts; and limited liability company, non-governmental organization, embassies and high commission, and church accounts.

The company also offers term loans and leasing services; overdrafts, receivable/invoice discounting, and LPO finance services; import and export finance facilities; MSME and scheme loans; education loans; and bonds and guarantees.

In addition, it provides personal funds management and investment, advisory, home remittance, and trust formation; import letters of credit, import bills for collection, non-valid for forex/advance payment, export transactions, invisible remittance, and e-services; and collection, payment, and reporting solutions.

Further, the company offers electronic banking services; virtual, credit, debit, prepaid, multi-purpose, branded and loyalty, and corporate cards; internet banking; and general and life insurance products and services.

Additionally, it operates branches; cash centers; ATM terminals; and POS terminals. The company was formerly known as Zenith International Bank Limited and changed its name to Zenith Bank Plc in May 2004.

Zenith Bank Plc was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.
ZENITHBANK.Key Executives: Adaora Umeoji (Chief Executive Officer); Abiodun Durosinmi (Chief Financial Officer); Michael Anyimah (Head of Investor Relations)

ZICHIS.Description: Zichis Agro Allied Industries PLC, an agricultural company, engages in livestock production, agro-processing, and allied agricultural services. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Ogun, Nigeria.
